name: prompt-enhancer
description: Prompt enhancer for ZCode: rewrite draft prompts into clear, concise, unambiguous instructions (concise-first contract, at most one file anchor) via the desktop input-box ✦ button, the /enhance-prompt slash command, or the enhance_prompt MCP tool. Supports GLM (Z.ai), OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic providers.

provider.description: Enhancement provider: glm (Z.ai), openai-compatible (custom base_url), anthropic, or mock (offline test). Falls back to the first provider with an API key when unset.

api_key.description: API key for the selected provider. Leave empty to read PROMPT_ENHANCER_API_KEY / provider-specific keys (ZAI_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) from the environment. When no key is configured, /enhance-prompt degrades to agent-side enhancement with the same rule set.

base_url.description: Optional API base URL override. Defaults: glm=https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4, openai-compatible=https://api.openai.com/v1, anthropic=https://api.anthropic.com.

model.description: Model id for the selected provider. Defaults: glm=glm-4.6, openai-compatible=gpt-4o-mini, anthropic=claude-sonnet-4-5.

timeout_seconds.description: Hard wall-clock timeout in seconds for one enhancement request (15-180).
